newsitem.title: HUNGARY: PANNONPLAST BOOSTS STAKE IN UNIT.
newsitem.headline: PANNONPLAST BOOSTS STAKE IN UNIT.

text.p: Hungarian plastics group Pannonplast Rt said it boosted its stake to 70 percent from 50 percent in its subsidiary Greiner-Pannonplast Kft by acquiring a 20 percent stake from the co-owner.

At the same time the co-owner Greiner und Soehne GmbH sold its remaining 30 percent stake to a unit of Swiss investment group Tamaro, Pannonplast said in a statement on Friday. The company was renamed Pannunion Csomagoloanyag Kft.
"The change was due to a difference in the foreign expansion strategy of the co-owners," it said.
Pannunion's co-owners also decided to raise the company's registered capital by 567 million forints to 2.021 billion forints, leaving the ownership structure intact.
The raise which aims at development purposes, will be effective April 17, it said.
Pannonplast also said it will merge its wholly-owned unit Centroplast Kft, into Pannunion Kft.
